name: gcob/lara-spec-first
description: A Spec-First API framework and integration layer for Laravel. Define your contracts with OpenAPI, generate stubs for AI, mock endpoints instantly with Faker, and seamlessly bridge legacy code.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest test suite. Runs at 512M, like `analyse`: tests/Conformance/KnownParserBugsTest.php reads a large stderr back from a child process, and PHP's common 128M default fails it with a fatal that has nothing to do with the change under test.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the test suite with a coverage report. Same 512M as `test`, for the same reason.
scripts-descriptions.artisan: Run an Artisan command inside the Workbench application: `composer artisan -- route:list`. A package has no artisan binary of its own; Testbench provides one.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Report formatting issues without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.format:md: Reflow Markdown prose to the .editorconfig column limit and align tables. Runs Prettier outside the PHP container, since the image carries no Node.
scripts-descriptions.format:md:check: Report which Markdown files need reformatting, without changing them.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every pre-pull-request check: formatting, static analysis, tests.
scripts-descriptions.check:lowest: Run the same checks against the lowest supported Laravel and Testbench, then restore the newest. Development tooling is left alone.
scripts-descriptions.build: Rebuild the Workbench application (assets, database, migrations).
scripts-descriptions.serve: Serve the Workbench application on the PHP development server. Binds 0.0.0.0 so it is reachable from outside the Docker container; running natively, this also exposes it on your local network.
